'''Tuatara Lone''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] holo [[Actor/Legends|actress]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]]. She was known for portraying madcap girls with odd lifestyles or nosy investigators capable of bluffing their way out of any problem. [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Kell Tainer]] fell in love with her during his teen [[Standard year/Legends|years]], and was heartbroken when he learned that she was happily [[Marriage/Legends|married]] with three children.<ref name="WS" />
